$comment: HUP gate g3-licence: licence inventory for everything Citrate Core ships in its installer, downloads on first run, or bundles as text (knowledge corpus, reviewed skills).

Checked by scripts/licence-inventory.mjs against the bundle configs, components/toolchain-bundle.json, templates/deps.lock.json, skills.lock and (with --corpus) a staged knowledge corpus. The review and the draft source offer are in docs/LICENCE_REVIEW.md.
covers: externalBin:<path> and resource:<path> (tauri.bundle-*.conf.json), toolchain:<name>, library:<name>, skills:<label>, corpus:<source id>, planned:<name> (not shipped yet).

review: ok = what ships meets the licence's notice obligations; action = a known gap with a concrete fix; owner = needs an owner or counsel decision. Commits and versions for corpus and skills sources live in the corpus manifest and skills.lock, not here (one source of truth).
Nothing in this file is legal advice. sign_off stays pending until the owner or counsel signs the review.

components.name: llama.cpp (llama-server and its dylibs)
components.note: v0.5.0-rc.4 (2026-10-11): the macOS runtime is llama.cpp b10909 (a2878d30d) built from source with -DLLAMA_BUILD_WEBUI=OFF -DLLAMA_USE_PREBUILT_UI=OFF and upstream's macos-arm64 options otherwise (runtime-deps llama-runtime-arm64-b10909-nowebui.tar.gz and llama-server-aarch64-apple-darwin-b10909-nowebui, pinned in src-tauri/runtime-deps.sha256; docs/RELEASE.md section 3). Checked: the build embeds 0 UI assets (libllama-server-impl __TEXT,__const 0.2 MB against 3.3 MB upstream, no gzip streams; b10909 always compiles the empty llama_ui_* accessors), GET / answers 404, health, chat completion and embeddings work. This closes the 2026-10-08 finding that the macOS and Windows llama-server embedded the web UI (an 8.9 MB SvelteKit bundle with no notices). Windows must also be built WEBUI=OFF: for rc.4 the Windows lane builds llama-server from source at the same tag with the same two options (docs/RELEASE_WINDOWS.md) instead of the upstream llama-b10909-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip; the Linux packages (b9438, LLAMA_BUILD_WEBUI=OFF, PROVENANCE-linux.txt) already have no UI. The runtime tarball carries LICENSE-llama.cpp.txt beside the dylibs. llama.cpp-vendored.LICENSE carries the texts of the code compiled into llama-server and its libraries, re-checked at b10909: cpp-httplib, nlohmann/json, stb_image, miniaudio, subprocess.h, the vendor/hash SHA-256 code and rotate-bits (libmtmd), and BoringSSL 0.20260903.0 with fiat-crypto (statically linked for TLS, LLAMA_BUILD_BORINGSSL=ON, as in every upstream release build; added at rc.4). Re-check vendor/ and the BoringSSL version when the bundled llama.cpp tag changes.

components.name: Citrate Core webview bundle (Vite build of src/)

Their notices are generated from the actual Vite output by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs (release/notices.json npm). MPL-2.0 and proprietary packages in node_modules (for example the MetaMask SDK pulled in by wagmi's connectors) are not in the output, which the generator checks on every run.
